label: Realized by a constituent: a being has a determination by one of its constituents
term: realized by (RealizedBy Realizes x k d)
definition: RealizedBy Realizes x k d: x has the determination d by its constituent k; k is the reality of d in x (Realizes, a declared primitive). Examples: a body has its shape by its form; on the classical account a simple being has its being, its wisdom and its power each by its one nature. Non-examples: a constituent that is a principle of limitation (prime matter, a bare limit) realizes no actuality; a cause outside x does not realize x's determinations. Distinguishing conditions: it is not identity of k with d (one constituent may realize several determinations distinguished by reason), and it is not causation. Whether realization at a simple being is real identity, and whether a constituent realizes the same determinations at every world (no accidents), are not encoded. Structural properties: none encoded.
